P1.TITLE: How can I create an account?
P1.ANSWER: To create an account, go to the registration section, enter your email, create a secure password, and complete your profile as a client or tattoo artist.

P2.TITLE: How do I book an appointment with a tattoo artist?
P2.ANSWER: You can book an appointment from the tattoo artist's profile. Select the date, time, and service you want. Then confirm the appointment and you will receive a notification.

P3.TITLE: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
P3.ANSWER: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule your appointment from the 'My Appointments' section. We recommend doing this at least 24 hours in advance to avoid charges.

P4.TITLE: How do reviews and ratings work?
P4.ANSWER: After your appointment, you can leave a review and rate the tattoo artist based on your experience. This helps other users make informed decisions.

P5.TITLE: How do I find tattoo artists near me?
P5.ANSWER: Use the search tool and enable location to see nearby tattoo artists. You can filter by style, price, ratings, and availability.

P6.TITLE: Can I communicate with the tattoo artist before the appointment?
P6.ANSWER: Yes, you can send messages to the tattoo artist from their profile or from the appointment details once confirmed.

P7.TITLE: How do I report a problem with a tattoo artist or appointment?
P7.ANSWER: If you had a bad experience or there was a problem, you can report it from the tattoo artist's profile.

P8.TITLE: What if a tattoo artist doesn’t show up for the appointment?
P8.ANSWER: We regret the situation. Please report it through the support section so we can help resolve the case and apply the appropriate policies.

P9.TITLE: Can I save my favorite tattoo artists?
P9.ANSWER: Yes, you can mark tattoo artist profiles as favorites to easily access them later.

P10.TITLE: How can I register as a tattoo artist?
P10.ANSWER: From the registration screen in our other app. Complete your professional profile, add photos of your work, services, prices, and availability.

P11.TITLE: What security measures are in place to protect my data?
P11.ANSWER: Your information is protected through encryption and security protocols. We do not share your personal data without your consent.

P12.TITLE: How can I edit my profile?
P12.ANSWER: You can modify your personal information and more from the 'Profile' section in the app.

P13.TITLE: Can I receive appointment reminders?
P13.ANSWER: Yes, we will send you push notifications before your appointment so you don’t forget.

P14.TITLE: What tattoo styles can I find?
P14.ANSWER: You can search tattoo artists by styles such as realism, traditional, minimalist, blackwork, among others, using the search filters.

P15.TITLE: Can I upload references or ideas for my tattoo?
P15.ANSWER: Yes, you can upload reference images when booking your appointment or send them directly to the tattoo artist via chat.

P16.TITLE: How can I delete my account?
P16.ANSWER: You can delete your account from the settings section. Note that this action is irreversible and all your data will be lost.

P17.TITLE: Can I book multiple appointments at the same time?
P17.ANSWER: Yes, you can book multiple appointments with the same tattoo artist or different artists, depending on your availability and needs.

P18.TITLE: What if I forget my password?
P18.ANSWER: On the Account screen within your profile or when logging in, click 'Forgot your password?' and follow the instructions to reset it.

P19.TITLE: How do I contact support if I have a problem?
P19.ANSWER: You can contact support from the 'Help Center' section or by sending an email to almeyda.dw.studio@gmail.com.

P20.TITLE: Can I change my personal information?
P20.ANSWER: Yes, you can update your personal information, including name, phone, and profile picture, from the 'Profile' section.
